goal: Symptom (operator 2026-10-18): in the DeepSeek chat the AIBridge 'Hands-free: DSA runs every AIRUN block on its own' checkbox (scripts/aibridge/extension/content.js, v0.7.0, af9f3446) is unchecked mid-conversation between terms, without the operator touching it. Code paths that set autoRun false: stopAuto() from the checkbox change handler (operator only), runBatch 'post failed' (postParts false), the per-chain cap (CFG.aibridge_cap 50, runs resets only at a finished chain), orphan() after an extension reload. Fix: find which path fires, keep deliberate safety stops but make them visible and re-armable without reload, remove any silent uncheck.
note: Root cause (code trace, v0.7.0 content.js): autoRun goes false only through stopAuto() and orphan(); refreshUi() copies autoRun into the checkbox, so any stop unchecks it. Paths: (1) change handler: operator click only, not it. (2) orphan(): fires only when chrome.runtime.id is gone (extension reloaded), status says so, not it. (3) per-chain cap: runs++ per block, reset only when a chain ends with pending empty; a long DSA dialogue with a block in every reply never resets, and at 50 stopAuto fires; the status text told the operator to 'press Reset', a button that does not exist; re-arm is untick+tick. KEPT as a safety stop, message fixed. (4) post failed: postToChat() judged the send by inputText(el2), the node typed into; if DeepSeek replaces the input node after send, el2 stays detached with our text, so the send counts as failed and stopAuto('post failed') fires even though the message went through. FIXED: L.postLanded(before, now) judges by the chat's current input node. Also the 180 s wait-for-idle path returns false the same way. (5) the status reason was lost: runBatch overwrote the reason and watchdog() rewrote it within 2 s with 'reply complete, N block(s) waiting: click Run' while autoRun was false, so the stop looked like no reason at all. FIXED: stopHold keeps the stop reason on the status line until re-armed. Evidence: node tests/handsfree.test.js fails on v0.7.0 loop.js (TypeError: L.postLanded is not a function, exit 1) and passes after. UNVERIFIED here: which path fired in the operator's chat; the DeepSeek DOM replacing the input node is inferred, not observed. The operator should read the status line (and window.__aibDebug()) after the reload to see which stop reason appears.
title: AIBridge: hands-free checkbox unchecks mid-chat (DeepSeek)
